thread:
Cassie: Kicking off BridgeCare onboarding. Goal: pilot two clinics over 8 weeks, prove clinician task completion and data accuracy. Need to align owners, success criteria, and major risks (SSO, PHI mapping, adoption). Who's the primary contact?
Rohan: Hey team  Rohan here (BridgeCare PM). Internal owners: Neha (IT), Omar (Data), Dr. Patel (Clinical). Data stays in us-west-2 per contract.
Cassie: Thanks. High-level milestones: Week 0-1: staging access + sample export; Week 2-3: mapping + smoke; Week 4-6: pilot; Week 7-8: iterate + go/no-go. Go/no-go gate = mapping + 72h smoke.
Ellen: SE note  please provide a 100-row NDJSON sample with masked PHI by 2026-08-04. If note sizes >6KB we'll recommend chunking.
Marcus: Infra/security: we need SAML SSO metadata + DPA excerpt. Security review ETA = 7 business days after intake. Also request SOC2 Type II.
Priya: I'll run enablement. Proposed: 1.5hr clinician workshop, 30-min follow-up office hours weekly. Success metrics to propose: median task completion <120s, ingest error rate <0.6%, pilot retention 14-day >60%, and 30-day DAU target = 150. Renewal risk triggers: adoption <40% or >2 incidents/week.
Rohan: Noted. We'll also track qualitative feedback via 10-min interviews and in-app 3-question survey.
Cassie: @OnboardBot create task "BridgeCare sample + mapping" assign: Rohan, Ellen due: 2026-08-04.
OnboardBot: Task created: "BridgeCare sample + mapping" assigned to Rohan, Ellen. Due 2026-08-04.
Ellen: Quick integration snippet for staging auth (dev only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGE_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"patient_id":"bc-01","note":"patient reported dizziness","ts":"2026-07-28T15:00:00Z"}'
```
Marcus: If SSO delays, we can do scoped invite provisioning for pilot users to avoid kickoff slip. Security prefers SSO but open to hybrid approach for first 2 weeks.
Priya: I'll draft the enablement checklist and sample slides, will post in #cs-ops by 2026-08-02.
Cassie: Action recap: 1) Rohan provide NDJSON sample (due 2026-08-04). 2) Ellen finalize integration doc + chunking guidance (due 2026-08-06). 3) Marcus/security to run intake (ETA 7bd). 4) Priya prepare enablement + survey (draft 2026-08-02). 5) Cassie publish kickoff playbook and schedule weekly ops standups.
Rohan: We'll share clinician roster and SOC2 link by EOD 2026-07-30.
Cassie: Next check-in: Mon 2026-08-02 09:00 PT. Any blockers?
Rohan: SSO metadata is pending but legal is on it. Will update if it slips.
Priya: I'll capture feedback cadence and add a quick NPS pulse every Friday during pilot.
Cassie: Thanks team  I'll drop the kickoff doc link here after the meeting. :rocket:
